caseNameFull: The State of North Dakota, doing business as the Bank of North Dakota v. Olson, Collector of Internal Revenue
attorneys: Mr. James Morris for appellant., Solicitor General Hughes and Messrs. Seth W. Richardson, Sewall. Key, and Morton P. Fisher for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The appeal herein is dismissed for the lack of jurisdiction, upon the authority of § 240 (b) of the Judicial Code, as amended by the act of February 13, 1925 (43 Stat. 936, 939).
